name: @drafttracker/desktop
description: Draft Tracker — an MTG Arena draft companion
author: minimaple

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mv dist/preload.js dist/preload.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('../web/dist')) fs.cpSync('../web/dist','dist/web',{recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('assets')) fs.cpSync('assets','dist/assets',{recursive:true});"
